resources.string: Not available in this computer\'s terminal
Its key or sign-in was rejected
Its gateway can\'t use this model
Didn\'t answer in its last check
Failed its last check on this computer
Define it in a startup file the terminal\'s shell reads (for bash, ~/.bashrc), then start again.
Or add it to Persona as a model provider: those work in any terminal.
Fix its key, gateway or CLI on that computer, or pick another launcher.
A start with it that works clears this; otherwise it clears by itself after 6 hours.
A check or start with it that works clears this.
Its latest check on this computer failed, and automatic repair didn\'t fix it.

Persona found “%1$s” in this computer\'s login shell, but the shell new terminal tabs run doesn\'t have it: another shell, a container, or a startup file that stops early. New agents start in those tabs.
